behavior: When the content of a viewport becomes empty and the auto height of the viewport decreases to 0, the root measures the viewport. The parts lose `data-has-overflow-y`, `--scroll-area-overflow-y-end` becomes `0px`, the scrollbar unmounts and the viewport leaves the tab order. Base UI skips a viewport whose scroll height or scroll width is 0, so it keeps the old overflow, the scrollbar and `tabindex=0`.
